purpose: Staff record business mileage and a manager checks the month's claims. A small app, used only to prove the full council end to end.

roles.name: Staff
roles.whatTheyDo: Record the miles they drove for work

roles.name: Manager
roles.whatTheyDo: Check the claims from their team

records.name: Mileage claim
records.description: One journey claimed at a rate per mile

features.title: Mileage claims
features.story: A member of staff records the miles for a journey and sees the amount they can claim, worked out in whole pence at 45p a mile.

acceptance.given: Alice is signed in as Staff
acceptance.when: she records a journey of 120 miles at 45p a mile

acceptance.given: Alice has claimed 10 miles and 15 miles
acceptance.then: the claims show £4.50 and £6.75, and the total shows £11.25 (1125 pence)

retention.text: Claims are kept for 6 years, then deleted

backupDestination.detail: A USB disk kept in the office safe

assumptions: All amounts are in pounds sterling and held as whole pence
